routing.priority: Untouched regions first, then descending unread file count, then stable region ID; regions with no unread files are not assigned.
routing.diversity: Before repeating a top-level subtree, select the highest-priority region from an unrepresented top-level subtree when one exists. This takes precedence over untouched priority. Root direct files share a null subtree. Assign selected regions round-robin to agents.
routing.membership: assignedFilePaths is the exclusive full region membership; unreadFilePaths is the subset with no source receipt, for fresh inspection assignments. pathPrefix is exact navigation scope and may also match child regions for direct-files buckets.
routing.evidenceFollowing: Regions route initial inspection, not semantic ownership. Follow cross-region evidence through the source broker when needed.
routing.accounting: Inspected files have at least one source receipt; unread files have none. Search receipts do not count. Line counts union supplied inclusive ranges per file; missing ranges and unknown file lengths are not inferred. Metadata accounting does not establish semantic coverage or verify receipt provenance.
routing.partitioning: Split oversized directory groups at actual child directories up to maxDepth. Direct sibling files remain together; root direct files are individual regions. Depth-limited or indivisible groups may exceed maxRegionFiles.
